answer: Each identity must send one falcon through the nebula where the k-th falcon must gather Fib(k) comet shards at 10 credits each, so fake k pays 10 Fib(k) and each clone costs 1.618 times the last. Ten fakes pay 1,430 credits; a hundred pay 9,273,726,921,930,789,991,750. Two falcons chasing the same comet shard both miss it, so shards can never be pooled across clones.
